GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 435 (18 Dec 45) PH
(SCAPIN-457)
18 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Control of Traffic in poisonous beverages.
1. The illicit sale and trading of untaxed beverages containing methyl alcohol to members of the Allied Occupation Forces has resulted in a number of cases of death, blindness and severe illness among those who have consumed these beverages.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government is directed to provide by appropriate enactment that selling or trading in any food or beverage containing methyl alcohol or other poison, and the manufacture, distillation or possession of such food or beverage will be punishable by a fine of not less than 2,000 nor more than 10,000 yen or penal servitude for not less than three nor more than fifteen years, or both such fine and penal servitude.
3. The Imperial Japanese Government will rigidly enforce the enactment above directed and all existing Japanese legislation and regulations controlling the trading, manufacture and sale of alcoholic beverages and of methyl alcohol and other poisons.
4. English translations of the enactment issued in accordance with this memorandum, will be forwarded in duplicate to this Headquarters immediately upon publication.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.Allen
Colonel,A.G.D.
Asst Adjutant General
